title: PromptScript Approval Record v1

$schema.description: Schema URL, the version tag of the record.

prompt.description: Prompt id, `<@meta.id>/<key>`. No segment ends with a dot.

contentHash.description: Content hash of the approved bundle.

createdAt.description: Creation time, self-asserted and never used to decide.

environment.description: The only environment the approval counts for. Absent means every environment.

comment.description: Note of the approver, without control characters except newline and without lone surrogates.

maxWeight.description: Highest arm weight, in basis points, the approval counts for. A record with it never approves the entry hash and names its `environment`. Absent: a full approval.

signatureType.description: Signature format, see `signature`. Reserved, not written or read in this version.

signature.description: Armored SSH signature over the UTF-8 bytes of the RFC 8785 canonical JSON (`canonicalizeJson`) of the record without `signature`; `signatureType` is included. The signing namespace is `promptscript-approval-<role>`. Reserved, not written or read in this version.

description: Approval of one exact prompt version by one approver in one role, version 1. Unsigned: the record is a claim until the change adding it is reviewed.

GovernanceRoleName.description: Name of an approval role: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter. Windows device names are refused, since a role names a directory.

source.description: `asserted`: the identity is a claim, it binds through the review of the change that adds the record

value.description: Git host user handle, at most 100 characters after the `@`.

ApprovalApproverV1.description: Who approved, as the record states it.
